title: Change an original value
summary: Go: Change an original value. Store 9 through the pointer.
introduction: A pointer stores an address. & gets an address, and * reaches the value there.
learningObjectives: Change an original value with Go

blocks.text: Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.

blocks.title: Change an original value
blocks.code:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
score := 3
place := &score
*place = 7
fmt.Println(score)
}

blocks.text: &score gets the address. Writing through *place changes score itself to 7.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not read through a nil pointer.
